text:
ashley: FYI SaffronBank just opened a P1 — embeddings requests are timing out and they're hitting our SLA. Need clear dev commitments and a short-term fallthrough plan. Who can own the engineering side?

devon: Customer success has the timeline: first report 09:12 UTC, error rate ~18% for embed calls, customer sees 500s. They're asking for a mitigation within 2 hours. I can stay on comms.

mike: oncall taking initial triage. I ran `kubectl get pods -n inference` and saw several restart loops in pool-gamma. Pushing logs to the incident ticket.

tara: I can investigate KV cache/eviction issues — this looks like a memory blowup on patch-2026-03-17. Putting a breakpoint on the cache prune code path.

lin: If pool-gamma is unstable we should route SaffronBank traffic to dedicated pool-beta as a temporary fallback. Need ops approval. Latency + cost spike but preserves SLA.

ashley: good. lin, can you coordinate the routing? mike + tara will investigate root cause and estimate a hotfix ETA. sophia, can you confirm a PR and CR can land fast?

sophia: PR exists: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/6789 — fixes cache retention edge case and adds a safety guard. Needs a quick reviews from infra and runtime. I can shepherd. Estimated deploy if approved: ~90 mins.

mike: I'll open a blocker PR for the routing config: `route override saffronbank -> pool-beta` and post it here.

ops-bot: incident INC-8242 created, priority=P1, customer=SaffronBank, incident_channel=#inc-8242 (auto).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy job #deploy-778 queued for pool-beta routing change. Manual approval required.

tara: quick note — I can cut a minimal revert if the latest runtime change introduced the regression. That would be faster than the full PR hotfix. Need sign-off from runtime eng.

lin: ops gives thumbs-up for temporary routing if security checks pass. I'll start the routing playbook and request manual approval on the canary.

mike: PR for routing posted: https://git.redwood/repo/configs/+/1234 — reviewers: lin, tara. Please approve ASAP.

ashley: action summary: (1) mike -> push routing PR + request manual canary approval, (2) lin -> run routing playbook + ops checks, (3) tara -> debug root cause & prepare revert/hotfix, (4) sophia -> chase infra/runtime review for PR #6789, (5) devon -> keep SaffronBank updated. Target: routing live within 30 min, full fix within 2 hours if no rollback needed.

devon: communicating plan to customer, they'll accept routing to dedicated pool for now.

sophia: pinged runtime reviewers, added PR checklist and perf smoke tests.

mike: routing canary approved, proceeding to deploy to pool-beta now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy #deploy-778 started at 09:44 UTC. Monitoring logs to #inc-8242.

tara: confirmed root cause is KV cache pointer leak referencing pr #2026-03-17. Revert looks safe and smaller risk. ETA for revert + canary: 35-45 mins.

ashley: thanks team. I'll close the loop once customer confirms improved metrics. Keep updates short in this thread.

devon: SaffronBank acknowledges, watching for reduced 500s.

mike: routing live to pool-beta. Early telemetry shows error rate down to ~3%.

ashley: marking owners in tracker: eng-owner=mike, runtime=tara, infra=sophia, ops=lin. Please update the incident channel with exact timestamps and PR links.

lin: noted. I'll post the rollback playbook link and post-mortem stub once stabilized.
